description: Rules for identifying the style category of an outfit based on observable characteristics.

classic_menswear.silhouette: Proportional and balanced. Fitted but not tight. Jacket shoulders precise, trouser break clean. No extreme volumes — no oversized, no wide-wide.
classic_menswear.layering: Purposeful and formality-driven: shirt under blazer, knitwear over shirt, trench over suit. Never casual stacking.
distinguishing_features: Shoulder seam sits exactly at the shoulder bone
Collar always present — oxford shirt, polo, or dress shirt
Heritage garments as anchors: oxford shirt, chinos, blazer, loafers
Fit is the primary signal — not brand or logo
Outfit is occasion-appropriate above all else
No visible logos — style communicates through garment and fit

streetwear.silhouette: Oversized top + slim or tapered bottom, OR boxy wide top + wide bottom (Korean-streetwear hybrid). Strong vertical contrast between top and bottom volumes.
streetwear.layering: Visible layering: hoodie under jacket, flannel open over tee. Layers are often mismatched in brand or material.
distinguishing_features: Visible brand logos (Supreme, Palace, Nike, Off-White)
Graphic tees as statement pieces
Sneakers chosen first, outfit built around them
Athletic or sport-origin garments in non-sport context
Cargo pockets present on pants

korean_fashion.silhouette: Wide or relaxed bottom + fitted or cropped top. OR oversized structured top + wide bottom. Clean, deliberate proportions. Volume is controlled and intentional.
korean_fashion.layering: Minimal layering — maximum two visible layers. Overshirt over plain tee. Structured coat over thin knit. Never heavy or bulky.
accessories: no cap or bucket hat only
distinguishing_features: Muted, desaturated colors — nothing fully saturated
Tonal dressing — all warm or all cool temperature tones
Wide trousers are standard, not exceptional
Cropped jackets paired with high-waist wide pants
No visible logos or branding
Clean, uncluttered silhouette

techwear.silhouette: Articulated, tapered, or modular. Functional pockets visible on multiple garments. Layered but each layer has a specific function. Never soft or draped.
techwear.layering: Three-layer functional system: base (moisture-wick) + mid (insulation) + shell (weather protection). Each layer is visually distinct in function.
distinguishing_features: Functional hardware — every zipper, buckle, and strap serves a purpose
Pockets on jackets, pants, and bags in unusual placements (chest, thigh, forearm)
Weatherproof or water-resistant materials
Muted, tactical color palette — no bright colors
Trail runners or technical boots as footwear
Modular or attachment-compatible garments

contemporary_luxury.silhouette: Relaxed but precisely cut. Unstructured tailoring with natural drape. Soft shoulder, clean silhouette. No extreme proportions.
contemporary_luxury.layering: Refined and temperature-appropriate layering — fine turtleneck under sport coat, silk scarf under overcoat. Never bulky.
distinguishing_features: No visible brand logos or markings
Extraordinary fabric quality — cashmere, suede, silk
Precisely fitted but relaxed, not tight
Neutral palette — colors are restrained
Texture is the primary visual interest
Footwear is leather, suede, or fine materials — never athletic
Garments appear simple but feel exceptional

identification_decision_tree.question: Are any garments made from GORE-TEX, nylon ripstop, or technical weather-resistant fabrics?
Is the color palette dark/tactical (black, olive, stone, gray)?
identification_decision_tree.no: May be performance athleisure, not techwear

identification_decision_tree.question: Are visible brand logos present (Supreme, Palace, Off-White, Nike etc)?
Are sneakers the dominant footwear and are proportions oversized-top/slim-bottom?
identification_decision_tree.no: May be casual or smart-casual with branding

identification_decision_tree.question: Are the trousers wide-leg or relaxed, and is the color palette muted/desaturated?
identification_decision_tree.yes: Likely KOREAN FASHION — proceed to step 4K

identification_decision_tree.question: Is the footwear minimal (clean white sneakers, suede loafers) with no visible logos?
identification_decision_tree.no: May be casual wide-leg dressing, not specifically Korean fashion

identification_decision_tree.question: Is the fabric cashmere, fine merino, silk, suede, or double-face wool?
identification_decision_tree.yes: Likely CONTEMPORARY LUXURY — proceed to step 5L

identification_decision_tree.question: Is the silhouette relaxed and unstructured with no visible logos?
Are heritage garments present (oxford shirt, chinos, blazer, loafers) with precise fit and neutral colors?
identification_decision_tree.yes: Likely CLASSIC MENSWEAR — proceed to step 6CM

identification_decision_tree.question: Is the outfit occasion-appropriate and free of visible logos, graphic prints, or technical hardware?
identification_decision_tree.no: Mixed style or casual — check individual garment categories
